user.title: Connect to Household Budget
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the authenticated budget app and choose the existing OpenAI AI Task entity used for receipt extraction.

data_description.base_url: The local URL and exposed port, for example http://homeassistant.local:8099.
data_description.api_token: The same dedicated token configured in the Household Budget app.
data_description.ai_task_entity: An attachment-capable AI Task entity provided by the OpenAI integration.
